subject: Invoice destination change + VAT reclassification ahead of brand migration
messages:
From: Jillian Park <jillian@auroramarine.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming change to invoice destination and VAT handling

Hi Vanessa,

Quick heads-up from finance: Aurora closed its acquisition of HarborCo Shipping last week and we're consolidating billing and tax treatment under the new legal entity — Aurora Marine Logistics LLC — effective 1 May 2027. That will change the remit-to address and how VAT will be reported for our account.

Requested changes:
- New legal name on invoices: Aurora Marine Logistics LLC
- New remit address: 120 Pier View Drive, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94111
- New remit email: ap@auroramarine.com
- VAT/TIN: new entity has a different US tax ID and a European VAT registration for our EU ops (certificate attached).

Can Redwood:
1) Reissue outstanding invoices dated before 1 May to the old entity or advise a cutover approach?
2) Update our account records so future invoices use the new remit email and legal name?
3) Confirm what documentation you require to change remittance and VAT treatment (we attached the VAT cert for now).

We'd like a short mutual action plan so the cutover is clean — minimal disruption to payments.

Thanks,
Jillian Park
Director, Finance Operations
Aurora Marine Logistics
Attachments: Aurora_TaxCert_2027.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Jillian Park <jillian@auroramarine.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming change to invoice destination and VAT handling

Hi Jillian — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the close. We'll get your billing cutover planned so payments don't get held up.

Summary of what we need from you to proceed:
- Signed change order or LOA authorizing billing name/address change (DocuSign link below okay).
- Confirmation whether the new entity should be treated as a new customer record (new PO numbers) or a simple name change on the existing account.
- Copy of the new W-9 / tax registration (EU VAT cert received — thank you).
- Desired cutover date (you mentioned 1 May, is that hard?).

Proposed mutual action plan:
- By 14 Apr: Aurora returns signed change order + W-9 (or PO)
- By 20 Apr: Redwood QA changes in staging and reissues any invoices flagged for reissue
- 01 May: Go-live for new invoices using Aurora Marine Logistics LLC and ap@auroramarine.com

Notes on reissuing invoices: we can reissue pre-cutover invoices to the new legal name but payment application sometimes requires the old PO — if Aurora wants to keep old PO numbers we can accept a short memo confirming mapping. If you want us to hold payment processing during the transition for a small window, we can but it will delay cash application.

DocuSign change-order: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/placeholder-change-order
Redwood billing intake (fillable): attached (Redwood_Billing_Form.docx)

If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-min sync with Marissa and our billing ops to walk through the checklist.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Lead — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Jillian Park <jillian@auroramarine.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming change to invoice destination and VAT handling

Thanks, Jillian + Vanessa — looping in Sales Ops to make sure the acquisition-related billing doesn't accidentally break the committed capacity terms. Per deal records (DEAL-ACQ-8921): the committed monthly capacity and pricing remain in force for 12 months post-close. Two quick asks from my side:

1) Please send the new PO (if any) referencing DEAL-ACQ-8921 so finance can map spend to commitments.
2) If the legal entity is different and uses new bank wiring details, include a certificate-of-incumbency or bank letter for our payments team.

I'll attach the signed change order we prepared for Aurora as soon as we have signatures; once signed we'll route to finance to update records.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Signed_AMChange_Order.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Jillian Park <jillian@auroramarine.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming change to invoice destination and VAT handling

Looping in Finance Ops for final approval. Vanessa/Marissa — approve a one-time operational credit to smooth the cutover: $12,000 credit applied to the first invoice issued to Aurora Marine Logistics LLC. Also waive any late fees for invoices impacted by this migration through the end of May.

Finance Ops: please flag account DEAL-ACQ-8921 as "migration-credit-applied" and hold any automated late-fee assessments until 2027-06-01. Once Aurora returns the signed change order and new W-9, update the remit-to and VAT class in the billing system (we'll reissue the invoices identified in the attached list).

Thanks everyone — once we have the signed documents, ops should be able to complete the change within 3 business days.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
